# Workable | Product Overview

Workable is a full recruitment and basic HR platform that combines candidate searches, ATS, HRIS and Workable Agent. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
